subject: hep-th
title_original: Integrable sigma models with Haantjes structure on ${H_{4}}$ Lie group
authors: Mirenayatollah Bahadori, Ali Eghbali, Adel Rezaei-Aghdam
abstract: By solving algebraic relations for the conditions of Haantjes structure on a Lie algebra ${\G}$ and by using the corresponding automorphism group we proceed to classify all inequivalent algebraic Haantjes structures on ${\G}$. In this manner, we obtain 34 inequivalent algebraic Haantjes structures on the ${h_{4}}$ Lie algebra. We deform the chiral sigma model on a Lie group by using Haantjes structure on it. Then we try to obtain conditions on this structure such that the deformed sigma model remains to be integrable. Finally, using the ${h_{4}}$ Haantjes structures and solving this conditions three new integrable sigma models on the ${H_{4}}$ Lie group are obtained.
title_relatable: Three new integrable models found by classifying geometric structures
hook: Mathematicians systematically classified 34 geometric structures on a specific Lie group, then used them to construct three previously unknown integrable field theories.
summary: Integrable systems—ones that can be solved exactly—are rare and prized in physics. The authors classified all distinct geometric structures (called Haantjes structures) on the h₄ Lie algebra, finding 34 inequivalent ones. They then deformed a standard quantum field model using these structures and derived conditions under which integrability survives. Three new integrable sigma models emerged as a result.
